'''B-2B''' was an experimental battle droid based on the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]]. It was created at [[Imperial Research Station 61]] under the direction of [[Milosh Muhrlein]]. He hid the droid in a secret chamber in his office.

It was used to ambush [[Jahan Cross]] when he was on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to investigate Muhrlein for corruption. B-2B was destroyed in combat with [[IN-GA 44]].
